integrity: Finite characteristic-two homology and rotation matrices reproduced by a self-contained exact verifier; rational character independently recovered by signed face Lefschetz enumeration; integral classification proved by saturated-lattice and extension arguments; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral cyclic-rotation representation for the twelve-vertex Möbius ladder only; no claim for other widths, an integral full-dihedral representation or geometric equivariant splitting. title: The nonsplit integral rotation lattice of the twelve-vertex Möbius-ladder independence complex
